entity_id.description: The entity ID shown in Arthur Settings > OAuth Applications.
entity_id.title: Entity ID

ArthurOnlineOAuthCredential.title: Arthur Online OAuth
ArthurOnlineOAuthCredential.x-credential-instructions: Connect Arthur Online with OAuth. Enter the Entity ID shown above your applications in Settings > OAuth Applications. Your NoClick instance must have an Arthur OAuth application configured.

ScheduleConfig.description:
Schedule configuration from the frontend widget.
Fields accept Union[int, str] to support drag-and-drop references like
{{nodeId.values.field}} which get resolved at configuration time.

daysOfWeek.description: Days of week to run on (0=Sunday … 6=Saturday); empty = every day. Supported for seconds/minutes/hours intervals and daily schedules.
daysOfWeek.title: Daysofweek

windowStart.description: Part-of-day start as 24-hour "HH:MM" in the schedule timezone (e.g. "09:00"). Set together with windowEnd; interval frequencies only.
windowStart.title: Windowstart

windowEnd.description: Part-of-day end as 24-hour "HH:MM", inclusive — a run landing exactly on it fires (e.g. "18:00" runs the 6:00 PM tick).
windowEnd.title: Windowend

monthDayStart.description: Part-of-month start day (1-31), inclusive. Set together with monthDayEnd; a start after the end wraps around month end (25→5 = the 25th through the 5th).
monthDayStart.title: Monthdaystart

monthStart.description: Part-of-year start month (1=January … 12=December), inclusive. Set together with monthEnd; a start after the end wraps around the new year (11→2 = November through February).
monthStart.title: Monthstart

ScheduleConfig.title: ScheduleConfig

credentials.description: Credentials for this node (optional if using environment variables)
